aboutText: Based in Moonee Ponds, Tiling By Tommy is your trusted local expert for high-quality tiling, waterproofing, and bathroom renovations. We specialise in delivering precision tiling for floors, walls, and splashbacks for both residential and commercial projects. Our skilled team handles complete bathroom remodelling, regrouting, and durable waterproofing solutions, ensuring stylish, long-lasting results with a focus on reliability and customer satisfaction.
servicesText: We provide comprehensive tiling solutions across Moonee Ponds and surrounds. From complete bathroom renovations to simple repairs, our skilled team delivers precision workmanship using quality materials for a flawless, lasting finish.
